## Payments knowledge assistant: live operations
Every tile is a query over the last 7 days of Application Insights telemetry from the hosted API. **Cost is an estimate** (tokens times list prices written in `telemetry.py`), not the invoice. **Answer support** is a cheap lexical proxy for groundedness (the weakest sentence's share of words found in its cited passage), not a model-judged score. Traffic here is small, so treat any single day with caution.

content.title: Last 7 days at a glance
content.query: let ask = requests | where name has '/ask' | join kind=leftouter (dependencies | where name == 'fastapi.endpoint' | project operation_Id, endpoint = customDimensions) on operation_Id | extend cost = toreal(endpoint['payrag.cost_usd']), tin = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_in']), tout = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_out']), refused = tostring(endpoint['payrag.refused']) =~ 'true', reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.reason']), guard_reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.guard_reason']), support = toreal(endpoint['payrag.support_min']), qlen = toint(endpoint['payrag.question_chars']); ask | summarize Requests = count(), ['Failed %'] = round(100.0 * countif(success == false) / count(), 1), ['p50 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 50)), ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)), ['Refused %'] = round(100.0 * countif(refused) / count(), 1), ['Estimated cost USD'] = round(sum(cost), 4), ['Avg answer support'] = round(avg(support), 2)

content.title: Requests and failures per hour
content.query: requests | where name has '/ask' | summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc

content.title: Latency of POST /ask (ms): p50, p95, p99
content.query: requests | where name has '/ask' | summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc

content.title: Estimated cost per day (USD) and tokens
content.query: let ask = requests | where name has '/ask' | join kind=leftouter (dependencies | where name == 'fastapi.endpoint' | project operation_Id, endpoint = customDimensions) on operation_Id | extend cost = toreal(endpoint['payrag.cost_usd']), tin = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_in']), tout = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_out']), refused = tostring(endpoint['payrag.refused']) =~ 'true', reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.reason']), guard_reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.guard_reason']), support = toreal(endpoint['payrag.support_min']), qlen = toint(endpoint['payrag.question_chars']); ask | summarize ['Estimated cost USD'] = round(sum(cost), 5), ['Tokens in'] = sum(tin), ['Tokens out'] = sum(tout), ['Cost per request USD'] = round(avg(cost), 6) by Day = bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by Day asc

content.title: Why answers were refused or blocked
content.query: let ask = requests | where name has '/ask' | join kind=leftouter (dependencies | where name == 'fastapi.endpoint' | project operation_Id, endpoint = customDimensions) on operation_Id | extend cost = toreal(endpoint['payrag.cost_usd']), tin = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_in']), tout = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_out']), refused = tostring(endpoint['payrag.refused']) =~ 'true', reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.reason']), guard_reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.guard_reason']), support = toreal(endpoint['payrag.support_min']), qlen = toint(endpoint['payrag.question_chars']); ask | where refused | extend Reason = iff(reason startswith 'guardrail:', strcat('guard: ', guard_reason), reason) | summarize Count = count() by Reason | order by Count desc

content.title: Answer support per day (groundedness proxy): average and 5th percentile of the weakest sentence
content.query: let ask = requests | where name has '/ask' | join kind=leftouter (dependencies | where name == 'fastapi.endpoint' | project operation_Id, endpoint = customDimensions) on operation_Id | extend cost = toreal(endpoint['payrag.cost_usd']), tin = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_in']), tout = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_out']), refused = tostring(endpoint['payrag.refused']) =~ 'true', reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.reason']), guard_reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.guard_reason']), support = toreal(endpoint['payrag.support_min']), qlen = toint(endpoint['payrag.question_chars']); ask | where isnotnull(support) | summarize Average = round(avg(support), 3), ['5th percentile'] = round(percentile(support, 5), 3), Answers = count() by bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by timestamp asc

content.title: Model calls: latency (ms) and tokens by call type
content.query: dependencies | where name in ('llm.chat', 'embedding') | extend tin = toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), tout = toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) | summarize Calls = count(), ['p50 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 50)), ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)), ['Avg tokens in'] = round(avg(tin)), ['Avg tokens out'] = round(avg(tout)) by Call = name

content.title: Retrieval quality: hits, best score, and how often the semantic ranker fell back
content.query: dependencies | where name == 'retrieval.search' | extend hits = toint(customDimensions['payrag.hits']), top = toreal(customDimensions['payrag.top_score']), fallback = tostring(customDimensions['payrag.semantic_fallback']) =~ 'true' | summarize ['Avg hits'] = round(avg(hits), 2), ['Avg best score'] = round(avg(top), 3), ['Searches with no hits'] = countif(hits == 0), ['Semantic fallbacks'] = countif(fallback), Searches = count() by Day = bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by Day asc

content.title: User feedback (thumbs up and down, joined to the request by its trace id)
content.query: traces | where message == 'feedback' | extend Rating = tostring(customDimensions['payrag_rating']) | summarize Count = count() by Rating, Day = bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by Day asc

content.title: Drift signals per day: question length, refusal rate, best retrieval score
content.query: let ask = requests | where name has '/ask' | join kind=leftouter (dependencies | where name == 'fastapi.endpoint' | project operation_Id, endpoint = customDimensions) on operation_Id | extend cost = toreal(endpoint['payrag.cost_usd']), tin = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_in']), tout = toint(endpoint['payrag.tokens_out']), refused = tostring(endpoint['payrag.refused']) =~ 'true', reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.reason']), guard_reason = tostring(endpoint['payrag.guard_reason']), support = toreal(endpoint['payrag.support_min']), qlen = toint(endpoint['payrag.question_chars']); ask | summarize ['Avg question chars'] = round(avg(qlen)), ['p95 question chars'] = round(percentile(qlen, 95)), ['Refused %'] = round(100.0 * countif(refused) / count(), 1), Requests = count() by Day = bin(timestamp, 1d) | order by Day asc

content.title: How much telemetry is being stored (records per day by table): the cost guard
content.query: union requests, dependencies, traces, exceptions | summarize Records = count() by Day = bin(timestamp, 1d), Table = itemType | order by Day asc
